meta.name: deck-graphify-dark
meta.description: 深夜渐变 + 漂浮 orbs + SVG 力导向图谱 + JetBrains Mono

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成深夜渐变风格的力导向图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在深色主题下展示关系网络图
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to display relationship graphs in dark theme

howto.what: Claude 会生成暗色系幻灯片：封面是深夜渐变背景配浮动光斑和 SVG 力导向图谱，章节标题用彩虹渐变，代码/CLI 页用 JetBrains Mono 高亮，卡片用毛玻璃效果。面向 AI、知识图谱或开发工具发布演示。
howto.when: 当用户要求制作幻灯片或演示文稿，且主题涉及 AI、知识图谱或开发工具时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一份关于知识图谱的发布演示幻灯片
say.note: Claude 会按暗底图谱风格生成封面和布局。

say.text: 用 Graphify Dark 风格制作开发工具启动展示
say.note: 会套用彩虹渐变标题和代码高亮页面。

say.text: 做一个 AI 产品发布的幻灯片，带力导向图谱封面
say.note: 封面会包含 SVG 力导向图谱和漂浮光斑。

howto.what_en: Claude will generate dark-themed slides: cover with deep-night gradient background, floating orbs and SVG force-directed graph; rainbow gradient section titles; JetBrains Mono highlighting for code/CLI pages; glassmorphism cards. Aimed at AI/knowledge-graph/dev-tool launch decks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to create slides or presentations on topics such as AI, knowledge graphs, or developer tools.

say_en.text: Help me create a launch deck for a knowledge graph product.
say_en.note: Claude will generate slides in the dark graph style.

say_en.text: Make a dev-tool launch presentation using Graphify Dark.
say_en.note: It will apply rainbow titles and code highlighting.

say_en.text: Create slides for an AI product launch with a force-directed graph cover.
say_en.note: The cover will include an SVG force graph and floating orbs.
